topic_thesis: Your 'free' UPI fuel payments are secretly being targeted with transaction surcharges because fuel pumps refuse to absorb the backend MDR fees on high-value digital transactions.
strategic_angle: Expose the illusion of 100% free digital payments in India. When the government introduced interchange fees up to 1.1% on PPI-merchant UPI transactions above ₹2,000, razor-thin margin fuel retailers began pushing back, setting the stage for sneaky fuel surcharges or card/wallet convenience fees being quietly offloaded onto daily commuters.
key_statistic: 1.1% interchange fee on wallet-UPI transactions above ₹2,000
target_emotion: Betrayal and sudden vigilance at petrol pump billing counters
pinned_comment_text: Have you noticed fuel bunks asking you to pay cash or charging an extra ₹10-₹20 for digital scans? Comment 'FUEL' and we'll send you the exact RBI rules on merchant surcharges! ⛽👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Frame with high local relatability: 'Petrol Bunk UPI Scam-a? Free UPI-la Hidden Charges?'. Use punchy Tanglish lines like 'Scanners-la panam anuppumbothu extra charge podraangala?' and break down why bunk owners hate UPI transactions above ₹2,000.
